record.name: Counsel - AI Lawyer Assistant
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Counsel is your AI legal companion. Ask questions in plain language, review contracts before you sign, and create legal documents in minutes. Clear, jurisdiction-aware guidance, whenever you need it.

Legal help is expensive, slow, and intimidating. Counsel puts instant legal clarity in your pocket, so you can understand your situation before spending a dollar on consultations.

ASK ANYTHING LEGAL
Chat with an AI assistant built for legal topics. Get clear, structured answers about contracts, employment, housing, business, family matters, and more. Your conversations are saved, so you can pick up any matter right where you left off.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU SIGN
Upload a contract, lease, or agreement and get a risk analysis in moments. Counsel highlights problem clauses, explains them in plain English, and gives you an overall risk score, so you know exactly what you are agreeing to.

CREATE LEGAL DOCUMENTS
Generate polished contracts, formal letters, and court forms in three simple steps. Choose a template, add your details, preview, and share.

POWERFUL LEGAL TOOLS

Rights Scanner: understand your rights in any situation
Case Assessment: get a structured evaluation of your legal position
Court Forms: find and prepare the right forms for your matter
Cost Estimator: see what a legal matter might cost before you commit
Deadline Tracker: never miss a filing date or notice period
BUILT FOR YOUR JURISDICTION
Set your location once and Counsel tailors its guidance to the laws and procedures that apply to you. You can change your jurisdiction anytime.

YOUR DOCUMENTS, ORGANIZED
Every document you review or generate lives in one secure vault, ready whenever you need it.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
Your conversations and documents are protected in transit and at rest. Add Face ID lock for an extra layer of privacy. Your legal matters stay yours.

WHO COUNSEL IS FOR
Renters reading a lease. Freelancers sending contracts. Employees reviewing an offer. Founders drafting agreements. Anyone who wants to understand the fine print before signing it.

Counsel provides legal information and self-help tools. It does not provide legal advice and is not a substitute for a licensed attorney. For advice about your specific situation, consult a lawyer in your jurisdiction.

Some features require a subscription. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel anytime in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://counsel-law.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://counsel-law.web.app/eula
Support: support@worify.com

record.description_evidence:
OurFirm.ai is the AI-powered litigation workspace built for trial lawyers, litigators, and legal teams. Conduct legal research, analyze case files, draft motions and briefs, verify citations, manage discovery, and collaborate securely from your iPhone.

LEGAL RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS

• Search case law, dockets, court filings, and matter materials
• Work with Stella for AI-assisted research and analysis
• Verify quotations, citations, legal propositions, and authority
• Review and analyze case documents wherever you work

DRAFTING AND CASE PREPARATION

• Draft motions, briefs, discovery requests, correspondence, and other legal documents
• Organize matters, conversations, and documents in one connected workspace
• Continue work started in the OurFirm.ai web application
• Collaborate securely with colleagues and clients

BUILT FOR LITIGATION

OurFirm.ai connects legal research, drafting, citation review, discovery analysis, and case preparation in a workspace designed around the demands of litigation.

SECURITY AND CONFIDENTIALITY

OurFirm.ai is designed for confidential legal work with encrypted data, firm-level isolation, role-based access controls, and audit logging. Customer documents are not used to train AI models.

An active OurFirm.ai account is required. Available features may depend on your firm’s subscription and administrator settings.

IMPORTANT: AI-generated content may contain errors. Attorneys and other qualified professionals must independently review and verify all research, citations, factual statements, and generated documents before relying on or filing them. OurFirm.ai does not provide legal advice.

Effortless Document Analysis: Scan or upload documents in various formats (.docx, .pdf, .txt). Legalyzer’s sophisticated AI meticulously analyzes your documents, extracting key clauses, identifying potential risks, and summarizing the core content.


Intuitive Chat Interface: Simply ask your questions in natural language. Legalyzer's conversational AI delivers clear and concise explanations, addressing your concerns with unmatched speed and accuracy.


Ask Anything, Get Clear and Contextual Response such as: 
“What are my termination rights?”
“Am I liable for this clause?”
"What does this section mean?"

Save Time & Money: Avoid costly legal consultations and reduce the time spent deciphering contracts.


Reduce Risk: Identify potential legal pitfalls early on, minimizing disputes and protecting your business interests.


Gain Confidence: Understand your legal obligations with clarity and precision.


Access Legal Knowledge: Empower yourself with the knowledge to make informed decisions.

Need help writing a professional letter quickly and confidently? AI Legal Letter Wizard makes it easy to create clear, structured, and effective letters for everyday situations. Whether you're requesting a refund, contacting a landlord, submitting a complaint, or drafting an employment-related letter, our AI-powered assistant helps you generate polished content in seconds.
 
Designed for convenience and simplicity, AI Legal Letter Wizard provides customizable templates and intelligent writing assistance to help you communicate your concerns, requests, and information professionally. No legal expertise or advanced writing skills are required.
 
Create Letters for Common Situations
Generate personalized letters for a variety of needs, including:
• Refund request letters
• Landlord repair request letters
• Demand letters
• Complaint letters
• Employment-related letters
• School excuse notes
• General formal and professional correspondence
• Custom letter creation for unique situations
Just describe your situation, choose your preferred tone, and let the AI create a well-structured draft that you can review and personalize.
Choose the Right Tone
Every situation requires a different approach. AI Legal Letter Wizard allows you to select the tone that best matches your needs:
• Polite
• Formal
• Firm
• Very Firm
Whether you're making a respectful request or clearly expressing concerns, the app helps you create letters with the appropriate style and wording.
Save, Organize, and Reuse
Keep your important documents organized with built-in letter management tools.
Letter Library
Access all your previously generated letters in one convenient location. Quickly review, update, or reuse saved content whenever you need it.
Auto-Save Support
We automatically save your generated letters, helping you avoid losing drafts and making it easy to resume editing at any time.
Easy Sharing and Export
Once your letter is ready, you can:
• Copy the text for use elsewhere
• Share letters through your preferred apps
• Export letters for printing or record keeping
Communicate more efficiently without having to start from scratch each time.
Fast and Simple Workflow
1. Select the type of letter you need.
2. Enter the relevant details.
3. Choose your preferred tone.
4. Generate your letter instantly.
5. Save, copy, share, or export your final draft.
 
Premium Access
AI Legal Letter Wizard offers flexible in-app purchase options:
• Single Letter Purchase – Generate an individual letter when needed.
• 24-Hour Access Pass – Enjoy unlimited letter generation for 24 hours.
Choose the option that best fits your needs and create professional letters whenever you need them.
 
Download AI Legal Letter Wizard today and simplify the process of creating professional letters for everyday situations.
 
Disclaimer
AI Legal Letter Wizard to assist with drafting letters and communications. The app does not provide legal advice, legal representation, or attorney services. Users should review all generated content and seek professional guidance when appropriate.
 
All generated letters are templates for your review and personalization before sending.

Legal Genius is a smart legal technology platform built for lawyers, law firms, and corporate legal teams to simplify drafting, case management, and daily legal workflows using AI.

Whether you handle litigation, advisory work, or documentation, Legal Genius helps you save time, reduce manual effort, and stay organised from one secure app.

Key Features

AI Legal Drafting
Generate legal drafts in seconds using AI.
Access thousands of ready to use legal templates.
Automatically fill case details into documents.
Edit, customise, and export drafts anytime.

Case and Matter Management
Organise cases by court, client, and status.
Store case numbers, parties, dates, and notes.
Track hearings and important deadlines.
Quick access to case history and updates.

Court Coverage and Automatic Case Updates
Automatic case updates across major Indian courts and tribunals.
Coverage includes the Supreme Court of India, all High Courts, all district courts, and consumer forums.
Tribunal coverage includes NCLT, NGT, RERA, DRTs, CESTAT, APTEL, and other statutory tribunals.
View case status changes, listings, and hearing updates in one place.

Smart Productivity Tools
Task and reminder management.
Notes linked directly to matters.
Clean and lawyer friendly interface designed for daily use.

Security and Reliability
Secure authentication and access control.
Strong data protection practices.
Your legal data remains private and protected.

Trusted by Leading Legal Professionals

Legal Genius is trusted by a growing community of legal professionals across India. Our users include reputed law firms and chambers such as Pragati Law, Chambers of S S Naganand, Mahesh YL, Holla and Holla, Kamal and Co, Indus Law Firm, along with many other established and emerging legal practices.

Who Is It For
Practicing lawyers.
Law firms.
Corporate legal teams.
Legal interns and associates.

Legal Genius is designed to assist legal professionals and improve workflow efficiency. It does not replace professional legal judgment or provide legal advice. All drafts and outputs should be reviewed before use.

record.name: August: Legal AI Workspace
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
August is the legal AI platform used by law firms and in-house teams on five continents. The mobile app gives you the same Assistant, agents, documents and history you use on your laptop.

Ask a question, get a sourced answer.
Look up a precedent, check a statute or confirm a deadline from wherever you are. Every answer comes with citations you can open and verify against the source document.

Work from your matter folders.
Your files are organized by matter and available on your phone. Open a shareholders agreement, a board minute or a compliance checklist and ask August about it directly.

Compare agreements with your precedent.
Attach two side letters and ask which is the stronger precedent for your client. August reads both, writes a negotiation memo you can download as a Word document, and shows you the exact section each finding comes from.

Run agents built for your firm.
August comes with hundreds of specialized legal agents, and firms configure their own around their templates, house style and jurisdiction. The agents you use on desktop run on mobile too.

Start on your phone, finish on your laptop.
Open the same conversation on any device and pick up where you left off.

The same security everywhere.
Client data on mobile has the same protections as on desktop: SSO, encryption at rest, data residency controls and audit logs.

August is used by solo practitioners, regional firms and Am Law 100 partnerships across litigation, corporate, regulatory and in-house practice.

Learn more at august.law
